scope_note: Stage-1 downstream interface increment making supplied exact radial-average callbacks authoritative at X=0 as well as X>0. It does not implement AxisCoefficientSpace, naturalRemainder, x2, a fixed point, or any missing profile field and does not overlap Agent 6's backend lane.

layers.landed_capability: When LeadingProfile receives an exact average callback, _average consults it for all admissible X including X=0; only profiles without an exact callback use U(0,eta) as the axis fallback.
layers.remaining_boundary: No genuine backend average is created here. AxisCoefficientSpace/naturalRemainder/x2/fixed-point closure, actual phi/u/average/pressure materialization, NaturalProfileAssembly, regular-inner-core/heat-exterior matching, support/moment/matching/cone closure, full reconstruction, and paper-exact velocity remain open.
